body: Pre-registered test (research_notes/Macro/ey_gsec_gap_test.md). Data: NSE ind_close_all month-end Nifty P/E + DY (from Feb-2012 only; niftyindices older P/E not scriptable), FRED INDIRLTLT01STM 10-yr (from Dec-2011). 177 months 2012-02..2026-10; 3-yr 141 starts (~5 independent), 5-yr 117 starts (~3 independent). H1 P/E alone FAILS: EY slope NW t -0.46 (3y) / -0.40 (5y), OOS R2 (fit <=2016, test 2017+) -0.97 / -2.11. H2 gap beyond P/E: literal rule met (OOS R2 gain +0.29 / +1.03, y10 coef negative both halves) but every model's OOS R2 is negative (M1 -0.68 / -1.08; gap alone -0.11 / -0.42), so in substance no usable information; rule flaw noted (should require OOS R2>0). In-sample the gap fits 5-yr returns (R2 0.17, NW t 3.45) - suggestive only. Gap always negative in sample (-4.3 to -1.45 pp); Nov-2026 reading -2.41. Consequence: gap is context only on the macro snapshot; not used by the decision card. Does not refute the Freefincal tail claim (negative 5-yr only from P/E>=24.5) which relies on 2000/2008 peaks outside this window.
title: Nifty earnings-yield minus 10-yr G-sec gap vs P/E: no out-of-sample predictive power for 3/5-yr returns (2012-2021 starts)
